\begin{table*}[t]
\centering
\caption{Optimizations applied to SCALE-Sim. Each one leaves the simulated behavior unchanged:
reports and all per-layer SRAM/DRAM traces are identical to the unmodified simulator. The
last two columns give each optimization's share of the total time saved in the two profiled
GoogLeNet runs (Fig.~\ref{fig:breakdown}).}
\label{tab:optimizations}
\small
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}l l X X r r@{}}
\toprule
\# & Component & Bottleneck in the original code & Change & \multicolumn{2}{c}{Share of saving} \\
\cmidrule(l){5-6}
 & & & & CALC & USER \\
\midrule
1 & Per-cycle progress-bar objects & A \texttt{tqdm} progress-bar object (display disabled) was constructed on every simulated cycle in the read- and write-servicing loops. & Plain loops; the object is no longer created. & 41.4\% & 12.2\% \\
2 & Prefetch-order diagonal flatten & Per-element Python loop with scalar indexing to reorder the operand matrix along anti-diagonals, $O(MN)$ interpreted steps per layer. & One vectorized NumPy gather per diagonal. & 0.9\% & 0.3\% \\
3 & CALC hit/miss lookup & Every address lookup scanned all sets in the active window: $O(W)$ per address, per cycle. & Map from address to most recent set id; $O(1)$ window test. & 30.1\% & -- \\
4a & USER hit/miss lookup & Every address lookup scanned all lines in the (wrapping) active window. & Static reverse index from address to line ids, built once per layer. & -- & 1.6\% \\
4b & USER fetch-matrix layout & Element-by-element copy with index arithmetic to reshape the fetch matrix. & Single pad-and-reshape. & -- & 1.4\% \\
5 & Read DRAM trace construction & Each DRAM prefetch concatenated onto the whole trace so far: $O(n^2)$ copying over $n$ prefetches. & Chunks collected in a list, joined once when first read. & 11.3\% & 83.3\% \\
6 & Write DRAM trace construction & Each write-buffer drain concatenated onto the whole trace so far: $O(n^2)$ copying. & Geometrically growing pre-allocated buffer, amortized $O(n)$. & 10.2\% & 1.1\% \\
\midrule
-- & Unchanged code & \multicolumn{2}{l}{Run-to-run variation in code not modified} & 6.1\% & 0.2\% \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
\end{table*}
